newsitem.title: USA: NFL-BRONCOS SIGN DE PRICE TO 5-YEAR, $4.9 MILLION DEAL.
newsitem.headline: NFL-BRONCOS SIGN DE PRICE TO 5-YEAR, $4.9 MILLION DEAL.

text.p: The Denver Broncos signed their first-round draft choice on Thursday, inking former Clemson defensive end Trevor Price to a five-year, $4.9 million deal.
Pryce, who was the 28th overall selection, joins a defensive line already bolstered by the signing of free-agent, defensive end Neil Smith from the Kansas City Chiefs.

The 6-foot-5 (1.95 meters), 278-pound (126 kg) Pryce, transferred from Michigan after the 1994 season. He had 74 tackles amd 7-1/2 sacks, 20 quarterback pressures and 20 tackles for losses in 1996, despite playing in only nine regular season games.
Pryce, the Defensive MVP in the Peach Bowl, set an all-time Clemson record for the 40-yard dash by a defensive lineman, clocking 4.74 seconds last February.
